checks.method: Read residual_profile_of_profile_a in ProfileABridge.lean and its use by no_profile_a_of_intersecting_twenty_seven in ProfileAClosed.lean; compared with the two-star terminal assembly in TwoHighEighty.lean.
checks.observation: ProfileABridge constructs H by filtering the original F, proves H has 61 members, obtains the twelve-point link support, defines the four outsiders as a support difference, and derives residual degree bounds using actual pair stars. The contradiction is therefore applied to a proved residual object rather than to an assumed numerical census. For B, the literal profile supplies two high points and their non-cooccurrence; the theorem derives the other-degree cap and the actual residual trace and degree hypotheses before applying incidence.

checks.method: Traced concentrated_impossible to heavy_design_keys_card_le_five in GenericHeavyExtensions.lean and contrasted that path with retained ExtensionPairs.lean and HeavyExtensionPairs.lean; checked the revised Section 6 assurance statement.
checks.observation: The terminal concentration argument proves extension cardinality from design codegrees, finds a common heavy extension point, and injects keys into the five blocks through that point. It does not call the older canonical extension_pair_injective theorem, although its module is imported transitively. Small kernel-reduced finite lemmas can exist in the development without making the external SAT or universal45 experiments premises. Section 6 now explicitly distinguishes the local structural proofs from the external enumerative I(27) used by Corollary 4. No additional ethical issue arises from these finite abstract-set checks.
checks.scope: Finite computation versus mathematical proof dependence

content.summary: The required bridge from literal Profile A to an actual residual family is present, including support, residual cardinality and degree obligations. The two-star root likewise supplies actual-family incidence hypotheses. The concentration endpoint uses the generic design proof rather than the older canonical extension-pair computation; exploratory SAT and universal45 diagnostics remain outside the local theorem premises.
